metadata.article_title: Discharge of the functions of the Governor in certain contingencies

article.title: Discharge of the functions of the Governor in certain contingencies
article.content:
160Discharge of the functions of the Governor in certain contingencies

Article 160 · Part VI · The Governor
The President may make such provision as he thinks fit for the discharge of the functions of the Governor of a State in any contingency not provided for in this Chapter.
